rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a doctor.

example.english: I need to see a doc tomorrow.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 tai2 ji1 sang1

rows.note: Use this for a documentary film or television programme.

example.english: This doc about ocean pollution is really worth watching.
example.traditional: 呢套紀錄片講海洋污染，好值得睇。
example.jyutping: ni1 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin3 gong2 hoi2 joeng4 wu1 jim5 hou2 zik6 dak1 tai2

rows.note: Use this for a document or a body of technical or legal documentation.

example.english: We need to let the lawyer look at this doc.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 jiu3 bei2 leot6 si1 tai2
